category: traffic bundle (Vietnamese: prepaid download traffic that anyone can redeem without an account)

free_tier.stated: No free tier: traffic is bought up front. 'Dung lượng Traffic 200GB / 1000GB / 3000GB ... Giá bán 150.000 VNĐ / 600.000 VNĐ' (the 3000 GB price did not render on either read).
free_tier.notes: The unit is redeemed traffic, not stored bytes and not time.

retention.stated: 'Không giới hạn thời gian sử dụng' - the traffic balance does not expire
retention.notes: No expiry is the distinctive part: the bundle is a balance, not a subscription.

egress.terms: Traffic is consumed by other people's downloads of the link: 'dung lượng sẽ trừ dần đến hết tuỳ theo dung lượng file chia sẻ và số lượt người tải file'. Recipients download at high speed 'không cần đăng nhập tài khoản'.

interface_detail: Create a Directlink URL in the Fshare account; anyone with the URL downloads without signing in.
tooling: Browser; the generated link is a plain HTTP URL that any download manager or scraper can fetch, which is what makes it usable as a distribution path.
chaining: The only Vietnamese product found that prices bandwidth directly rather than time: one VND 600,000 bundle is a 1 TB distribution allowance that never expires, so it composes with any client that needs to serve files to third parties rather than to itself.

limits.value: 200 GB or 1000 GB of redeemed traffic per bundle

limits_note: No time limit at all; the entire constraint is the traffic balance.
binding_note: The bundle is pure volume, so 1 TiB/month needs one 1000 GB bundle per month; nothing else binds because there is no clock.

identity_cost.detail: Purchased through the same Fshare checkout as VIP and Fcode, which offers only Vietnamese rails (MoMo, ShopeePay, VNPAY, FPT Pay, SMS to 9029, domestic bank transfer). A recipient of the link needs nothing; the buyer is gated.

reliability_note: Traffic is consumed by strangers downloading the link, so a link posted publicly can burn a bundle in hours; there is no per-recipient cap and no refund of consumed traffic.
confidence_note: Page read twice (extract and raw) today; two of three prices are quotable and the third did not render. The purchase rail is inferred from the Fshare checkout pages read separately, which is why identity is country-phone rather than measured.

evidence.proved: 'Gói Directlink cho phép bạn tạo link tải nhanh cho file để chia sẻ với dung lượng lớn (3000GB)'; 'người nhận được link có thể tải file với tốc độ cao, không cần đăng ký tài khoản'
price table: 'Dung lượng Traffic 200GB 1000GB 3000GB ... Giá bán 150.000 VNĐ 600.000 VNĐ' and 'Không giới hạn thời gian sử dụng'

price_per_tb_month: VND 600,000 per 1 TB of redeemed traffic (no expiry)
notes: Distinct product from VIP: VIP is a time-based personal download plan, Directlink is a volume-based distribution plan. Needed this because every other Vietnamese offer prices time. Abandonment condition: the traffic balance starts expiring.
